headline: SG freebies: Katong-Joo Chiat stamp rally keychains end Sun 6 Dec; new S.U.R.E. Mission 2 bookmark at 16 libraries from Sat 21 Nov + 12 more
verdict: Finish the Katong-Joo Chiat stamp rally before Sun 6 Dec: six free stamps get you a guaranteed collectible keychain pack, while stocks last.

plan.do: Jurong Library: swap Broc's Buddies cards at Broc's Shop (11am–5pm), then solve S.U.R.E. Mission 2 for a free bookmark.
Ride the North East Line and collect 8 Design Trail stamps. Redeem the NELBD sticker pack at Nexus Punggol Coast (to 10pm).
Katong-Joo Chiat: stamps at 6 heritage food shops. Redeem the keychain pack at Joo Chiat CC (10am–9.30pm). Go early: while stocks last.
CBD lunch walk: pick up a passport at CHARLES & KEITH MBS and do 5 art stops for a limited-edition button pin.
